name: ocw-sandbox-browser
description: The bot browser container's stdio agent (07.8-07, D-05, D-07, D-11): drives Chromium over a pipe and answers sandboxd's browser ops with redacted snapshots, masked screenshots and screencast frames. Not a pnpm workspace package: installed with `npm ci` from package-lock.json (exact pin, sha512 integrity, no lifecycle scripts).
